title: Act: Add sound toggle and settings buttons wired to useUiStore
summary: Add store-wired icon buttons to HeaderOverlay
description: Add the sound and settings controls to the HeaderOverlay header.

steps.lines: after the Countdown block from ACT1
steps.action: Import useUiStore from '../store/uiStore', Button from './ui/button', and Volume2, VolumeX, Settings from 'lucide-react'. Read soundEnabled, toggleSound, toggleSettings via selectors. Render a Button aria-label="Toggle sound" aria-pressed={soundEnabled} onClick={toggleSound} showing Volume2 when enabled else VolumeX, and a Button aria-label="Settings" onClick={toggleSettings} showing Settings.
steps.code: <Button type="button" variant="ghost" aria-label="Toggle sound" aria-pressed={soundEnabled} onClick={toggleSound}>{soundEnabled ? <Volume2 aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" /> : <VolumeX aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />}</Button>
steps.expected: Two labelled buttons present and wired to the store
